raw_segments.text: Yes, perhaps I really did tell Grushinka about that fatal day, as Katia calls it.
Yes, I did tell her I remember.
It was that time at Makro.
I was sobbing then, kneeling and praying to Katia's image, and Grushinka understood it.
Damn it all, but it's bound to be so now.
Then she cried, but now the dagger in the heart.
